Capital Investment Counsel Has Lifted Position in Target (TGT) as Shares Rose; Intercontinental Exchange In (ICE) Position Maintained by Alpha Cubed Investments Llc
April 30, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Capital Investment Counsel Inc increased its stake in Target Corp (TGT) by 14.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Investment Counsel Inc bought 4,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 37,660 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.46 million, up from 32,760 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Target Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $39.25B market cap company. The stock increased 1.35% or $0.97 during the last trading session, reaching $72.85. About 3.71 million shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 28.46% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.91% the S&P500.
Alpha Cubed Investments Llc increased its stake in Intercontinental Exchange In (ICE) by 26.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alpha Cubed Investments Llc bought 9,637 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.21% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 45,702 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.23M, up from 36,065 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alpha Cubed Investments Llc who had been investing in Intercontinental Exchange In for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $42.25B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.33% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $72.72. About 1.90 million shares traded. Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) has risen 20.88% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.33% the S&P500.
Alpha Cubed Investments Llc, which manages about $320.00M and $765.95M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,402 shares to 239,125 shares, valued at $40.47M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in American Airls Group Inc (NASDAQ:AAL) by 67,767 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 4,900 shares, and cut its stake in Altria Group Inc (NYSE:MO).
